answer.camera_language: Warm, lightly breathing coverage draws closer as their interest grows; the caller display briefly arrests the frame, the father's demand brings the strongest inward move, and restrained distance returns as they part.

clips.motivation: Keep the first connection alive without making the handover feel ceremonious.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left, Kasun right, phone extended centrally, vehicle behind right
clips.lands_on: Both waist up, phone now at Anudi's right waist
clips.composition_note: Balance both faces across the central phone; retain their hands and the vehicle behind Kasun.
clips.why: A shared, gently living frame makes her gratitude feel spontaneous rather than staged.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level waist-up two-shot breathes very gently as the phone changes hands and she thanks him, keeping both faces and the handover clearly framed before settling.

clips.motivation: Give the returned object a tactile presence while keeping the hidden transfer simple.
clips.opens_on: Phone centered between cream sleeve left and faded blue sleeve right
clips.lands_on: Phone supported by Anudi's right hand, with room for its slight withdrawal left
clips.composition_note: Keep the handset central enough to conceal the transfer point; leave space for both hands to clear naturally.
clips.why: A tiny drift gives the phone weight without turning a simple return into a flourish.
clips.camera_sentence: A slightly high, waist-height insert drifts very slowly left as her right hand secures the phone, keeping the handset sharp and the transfer point concealed, then settles before his hand clears.

clips.trigger: Kasun holds her eyeline before replying
clips.motivation: Let his reassurance feel easy and unperformed.
clips.opens_on: Kasun chest and head on the right third, looking left
clips.lands_on: Kasun in the same chest-up framing, vehicle soft behind
clips.composition_note: Keep open space toward Anudi off frame left and preserve the vehicle behind his shoulder.
clips.why: His modest answer needs an attentive operator, not an emphatic move.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level medium close-up of Kasun on the right breathes very gently as he looks left and replies, keeping his face readable and the vehicle soft behind him, then eases to rest.

clips.direction: slightly right into her looking space
clips.motivation: Let the frame acknowledge her curiosity without leaving her speaking face.
clips.opens_on: Anudi waist up at left, phone low, umbrella above, vehicle edge at right
clips.lands_on: Anudi waist up with slightly more looking space toward the vehicle
clips.composition_note: Keep Anudi left throughout; the small lateral drift must not crop her phone or lose the vehicle edge.
clips.why: A nearly imperceptible drift lets her look lead us toward his livelihood.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level medium shot drifts very slowly right as Anudi smiles toward the business and asks her question, retaining her on the left with the phone low and the vehicle edge in depth, then settles.

clips.trigger: Her attention rests on the business
clips.motivation: Study the modest business as the object of her genuine interest.
clips.opens_on: Medium detail of the food three-wheeler enclosed on one side by its soft near edge
clips.lands_on: A marginally closer medium detail of the same vehicle, with no people visible
clips.composition_note: Retain the soft near vehicle edge without passing it; keep all people outside the frame.
clips.why: A very small approach gives her curiosity a physical point of view without inventing a reveal.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level medium view through the vehicle's soft near edge, the camera creeps very slowly closer to the food three-wheeler as her question continues offscreen, remaining a medium detail and settling with no people visible.

clips.trigger: They settle into the exchange about his business
clips.motivation: Preserve equality as practical questions become personal interest.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left and Kasun right, both waist up, vehicle behind right
clips.lands_on: The same balanced two-shot after her follow-up question
clips.composition_note: Match the first shared setup, keeping both faces equally weighted and the phone at her waist visible.
clips.why: Keeping them together lets the growing interest belong to both of them.
clips.camera_sentence: The eye-level waist-up two-shot breathes very gently through his answer and her follow-up question, keeping Anudi left, Kasun right and the business behind him, then eases to rest.

clips.trigger: L7, Kasun begins describing his independent start
clips.motivation: Give his quiet ambition increasing attention without making him seem boastful.
clips.opens_on: Kasun chest and head on the right third with the vehicle behind
clips.lands_on: A slightly tighter chest-up portrait of Kasun, still with looking room left
clips.composition_note: Begin at the established 65mm field and tighten only marginally, retaining chest and head and his right-third placement.
clips.why: A barely perceptible tightening gives his hope weight without advertising the camera.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level medium close-up zooms very slowly and slightly tighter as Kasun explains his small beginning and hopes, retaining chest-up framing, clear lips and looking room left, then settles as he finishes.

clips.motivation: Carry the warmth into the interruption while preserving a readable caller display.
clips.opens_on: Anudi's face upper left, right hand and phone low right, umbrella edge overhead
clips.lands_on: Anudi's face upper left and raised caller display foreground right
clips.composition_note: Reserve the lower-right screen space from the opening; retain usable depth across her face and the angled display without a focus change.
clips.why: The interruption should enter her existing frame rather than cause a conspicuous camera reaction.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level close-up breathes almost imperceptibly as Anudi's admiration is interrupted by the ringing phone, retaining her face upper left and the raised readable screen at right before settling.

clips.motivation: Make the father's identity an unambiguous, arresting interruption.
clips.opens_on: Phone display filling most of the image, Father readable, right hand supporting it
clips.lands_on: The same readable incoming-call display and supporting hand
clips.composition_note: Keep the full display within one focus plane and the word Father unobstructed; exclude her face.
clips.why: This deliberate stop gives the caller's identity authority and guarantees a readable screen.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a completely still, slightly high extreme close-up of the phone in her right hand, with the entire incoming-call display sharp and the word Father clearly readable throughout.

clips.trigger: Anudi brings the phone to her right ear
clips.motivation: Return to ordinary human warmth before the meaning of the call reaches her.
clips.opens_on: Anudi head and shoulders at left, phone raised, umbrella edge above
clips.lands_on: Anudi in the same medium close-up with phone at her right ear
clips.composition_note: Keep her left of centre with space right; allow her hand to rise without reframing or obscuring her lips.
clips.why: Her greeting is still ordinary, so the frame should not anticipate distress.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level medium close-up breathes very gently as Anudi raises the phone to her right ear and greets her father, keeping her face and lips clear on the left, then eases to rest.

clips.trigger: L11, her father begins his directive
clips.motivation: Let the outside demand gradually narrow her emotional space without revealing its remote source.
clips.opens_on: Anudi's face and phone in close-up at left with umbrella edge overhead
clips.lands_on: A tighter close-up of her listening face and phone, still retaining chin and forehead
clips.composition_note: Begin at the established 65mm field and tighten gradually, reducing but not eliminating right-side space; keep the father unseen.
clips.why: The strongest inward move belongs to the demand that changes the meeting, not to the earlier flirtation.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level close-up slowly zooms tighter on Anudi's silent listening face as her father speaks through the phone, retaining her full face and the handset while reducing the space beside her, then settles.

clips.direction: toward Anudi beneath the umbrella edge
clips.trigger: Her eyes settle while her father continues speaking
clips.motivation: Sustain the pressure from a more separated view without adding another dramatic escalation.
clips.opens_on: Anudi in three-quarter medium close-up left, umbrella edge above, vehicle dissolved far right
clips.lands_on: A marginally closer medium close-up with the same right-side negative space
clips.composition_note: Keep the soft umbrella edge at upper left rather than passing it; preserve the open space right and remain within MCU.
clips.why: A smaller, slower approach sustains the call's pressure without competing with the principal close-up.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level three-quarter medium close-up creeps very slowly toward Anudi as her gaze settles during the call, retaining the soft umbrella edge above and empty space to her right, then settles without reaching a close-up.

clips.motivation: Stop pressing inward and allow her subdued compliance to carry the change.
clips.opens_on: Anudi's face and phone close at left, umbrella edge overhead
clips.lands_on: The same close-up after her smile fades and she agrees
clips.composition_note: Keep right-side space and the full face readable; the operator's breath is nearly imperceptible, with no further tightening.
clips.why: Once the pressure has landed, her expression needs room rather than another emphasis.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level close-up breathes almost imperceptibly as Anudi's smile fades and she quietly answers into the phone, keeping the same framing and clear lips throughout before easing to rest.

clips.trigger: Anudi lowers the phone and returns her attention to Kasun
clips.motivation: Restore their shared space while allowing the altered mood to remain visible.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left with phone at ear, Kasun right, both waist up
clips.lands_on: Anudi facing Kasun with phone lowered after her farewell
clips.composition_note: Match the earlier shared setup exactly in balance; do not favour Kasun as though he knows the call's contents.
clips.why: Returning to the same two-shot lets the audience feel how much has changed without changing the geography.
clips.camera_sentence: The eye-level waist-up two-shot breathes very gently as Anudi lowers the phone, looks back at Kasun and takes her leave, keeping their original left-right balance and settling after she speaks.

clips.motivation: Observe his uncertainty without suggesting knowledge of the private conversation.
clips.opens_on: Kasun close on the right, looking into left negative space
clips.lands_on: Kasun close on the right with his eyeline returned to Anudi
clips.composition_note: Keep the left side open and the vehicle dissolved; do not chase the small eye movement.
clips.why: A quiet living portrait reads as concern, not revelation.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level close-up breathes almost imperceptibly around Kasun on the right as his eyes dip and return toward Anudi offscreen left, preserving the empty space beside him and settling with his gaze.

clips.motivation: Let his consideration remain simple after the interruption.
clips.opens_on: Kasun chest and head on the right third, looking left, vehicle soft behind
clips.lands_on: Kasun in the same medium close-up after wishing her well
clips.composition_note: Return to the original B framing and leftward looking room without renewed tightening.
clips.why: His farewell should offer warmth, not add pressure.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level medium close-up breathes very gently as Kasun looks left and wishes her well, keeping his face readable on the right with the vehicle soft behind, then eases to rest.

clips.direction: slightly backward from their diverging paths
clips.motivation: Allow separation to develop within the established roadside geography.
clips.opens_on: Both full figures, Anudi left, Kasun right, three-wheeler behind right
clips.lands_on: Anudi receding left and Kasun returning right, with both paths legible
clips.composition_note: Use only a few inches of backward drift; keep both full figures and the vehicle visible without following either person.
clips.why: Their movement should create the separation while the camera quietly makes room for it.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level wide shot drifts very slowly backward as Anudi leaves into left depth and Kasun watches before returning right, keeping both full figures and their paths visible, then settles near the vehicle.

clips.direction: backward across the wet roadside foreground
clips.trigger: Both continue away along their separate paths
clips.motivation: Leave the encounter resonating in the widening space between them.
clips.opens_on: Wet roadside foreground, Anudi small in left depth, Kasun in right depth beside the vehicle
clips.lands_on: A wider roadside view with more empty foreground and both figures separated in depth
clips.composition_note: Expand the wet foreground while retaining both figures and the business; stay wide rather than becoming an extreme wide.
clips.why: A short, unhurried retreat leaves the feeling of the meeting behind in the roadside space.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level wide shot pulls slowly backward as Anudi continues into left depth and Kasun approaches the business at right, expanding the wet empty foreground while retaining both figures, then settles.
